text.p: Cluckcorp International Inc said Wednesday that revenues from restaurant operations for the year ended December 29 were $263,000 compared with $226,000 for the prior year, while total revenues were $263,000 versus $276,000 for the year earlier.
The company said net loss was $2,011,000 for the year ended December 29, 1996 versus $924,000 for the previous year.
The additional loss for the current year resulted primarily from increases in general and administrative expenses of about $700,000 and interest expense of $300,000, the company said.
The company said it has four restaurants opened in the San Antonio/Corpus Christi area versus one restaurant opened as of last year.
Four additional restaurants are planned for the same area in 1997, the company said.
